notes.title: Laundry Store Simulator FREE Demo now available!
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3239280/Laundry_Store_Simulator_Demo/

Great news! Laundry Store Simulator now has a FREE demo available on Steam! Come on, try it out and experience the thrill of being a laundry business owner!

In this demo you will be able to play the opening sections of Laundry Store Simulator. There's no limit of how long you can play the demo, but available features and your progression are limited compared to the full game. Your progress and save data from the demo [b]can not[/b] be transferred to the full version of the game.

Don't forget to wishlist the game if you enjoyed the demo!

notes.title: Movie Cinema Simulator is Finally Out of Early Acess!
notes.notes:
The curtains rise, and the final scene unfolds... Movie Cinema Simulator is officially released!

This wouldn't have been possible without YOU, our incredible community! Your passionate critiques and supportive suggestions have been the guiding lights on our journey. You helped us polish the story, refine the experience, and ultimately, create the best Movie Cinema Simulator we could possibly imagine.
From the bottom of our hearts, thank you. You've helped us bring the magic of cinema to life, and we can't wait to see how marvelous your cinema will become!

notes.title: Movie Cinema Simulator is Now Available on Steam!
notes.notes:
Manage your own cinema in this first-person simulation game!

Sell tickets to customers that want to watch movies in your cinema!

Discover the following features in Movie Cinema Simulator :
♦ Collect 20+ movies to show in your cinema 🎬
♦ Decorate your cinema in your own style 🎀
♦ Upgrade your cinema to welcome more customers 🍿
♦ Increase your cinema’s rating to attract special customers 👩👨 
♦ Kick out thugs and delinquents who bothers your cinema 💪
♦ Keep your cinema clean 🧹
♦ Explore the big and mysterious city 🏙
♦ Decorate your house to be as pretty as possible 🏠
♦ Play minigames to get special rewards 🏀
♦ Recruit employees to help serve the customers 👩‍🍳👮‍♂️
♦ A first-person gameplay with lots of surprises to make your experience fun and exciting 🌟
♦ Complete achievements to get numerous rewards 🎁
♦ Follow the main story to return your grandfather’s cinema back to its glory days ✨
♦ Do side quests and get to know with the town citizen🎉
♦ It’s an offline game, so you don’t need an internet connection to play 👏

The PC version features :
♦ Customizable mouse and keyboard controls
♦ Rebalanced economy and progression
♦ No microtransactions

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2682120/Movie_Cinema_Simulator/
